properties.description:
Browser feedback 6: provide a graph view for TypeScript functions and methods so their dependencies can be inspected visually. Prefer a dependency-depth layout, consistent with the direction discussed for type graphs. Keep the represented relationships explicit and provide navigation between graph elements and their source declarations.

Should be accessible through right click among the context menu option for function / method.

Graph should handle circular and recursive call. Edge mean from -> call -> to (you don't need to put the call label).
properties.title: Add a TypeScript function and method dependency graph view
